item.title: Villanova Women’s Basketball Defeats Georgetown, 67-55
item.description: On Saturday, Feb. 7, Villanova Women’s basketball (19-5, 11-3 Big East) defeated Georgetown University at home, 67-55. The victory extends the Wildcats’ win streak at the Finneran Pavilion to 11 games and their overall win streak to four games.
